subject.title: fix(sessions): persist sender metadata in user turn transcript JSONL

question: Should OpenClaw persist senderId, senderName, and senderUsername in durable session JSONL for group/channel user turns while excluding phone-number identity and allowing hooks/redaction to remove display identity?
rationale: The implementation changes a durable transcript privacy boundary rather than only repairing an internal null path, so automation cannot choose the permanent sender-identity contract for maintainers.

options.title: Approve Bounded Non-Phone Metadata
options.body: Accept senderId, senderName, and senderUsername as durable group/channel transcript metadata while continuing to exclude senderE164.

options.title: Narrow The Persisted Fields
options.body: Require a smaller persisted set, such as senderId only, before changing the JSONL contract.

options.title: Request More Policy Documentation
options.body: Ask for explicit docs or maintainer notes describing the transcript privacy contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Non-Phone Metadata
recommendation.body: Accept senderId, senderName, and senderUsername as durable group/channel transcript metadata while continuing to exclude senderE164.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the recent branch commits that refined the sender metadata scope, hook behavior, and redaction boundary.
